name: mintcart-frontend
description: MintCart frontend build pipeline (Bootstrap 5 + vanilla JS, esbuild).

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.build:js: esbuild assets/src/js/catalog.js --bundle --minify --outfile=assets/dist/js/catalog.min.js && esbuild assets/src/js/admin.js --bundle --minify --outfile=assets/dist/js/admin.min.js && esbuild assets/src/js/slider.js --bundle --minify --outfile=assets/dist/js/slider.min.js
scripts.build:css: npm run build:css:index && npm run build:css:components
scripts.dev: npm run dev:js && npm run dev:css
scripts.dev:js: esbuild assets/src/js/catalog.js --bundle --sourcemap --outfile=assets/dist/js/catalog.js && esbuild assets/src/js/admin.js --bundle --sourcemap --outfile=assets/dist/js/admin.js && esbuild assets/src/js/slider.js --bundle --sourcemap --outfile=assets/dist/js/slider.js
scripts.dev:css: npm run dev:css:index && npm run dev:css:components
